text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having completed the crucial 'first three years' for an Umamusume,
as well as the Arima Kinen, Biwa Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the elder of the strongest sisters, she now—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Save me, Trainer-kun!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wha-wha-what...
S-Su-suh, S...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: N-No, that's not it! Brian just messaged my phone!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "Want to go somewhere on our next day off?" he asked!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't that reply a bit too casual?!
This is an emergency, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian went out of her way to invite me herself, you know?!
And she specifically asked for my day off!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: J-Just like real sisters...
choice_data_list: You two are sisters as well, right?
You two are sisters too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Guh... That's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's been a long time since Brian
actually invited me to go somewhere with her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Especially since this is taking up her personal time. If so, she might have a request, or perhaps an important matter to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "If she were to consult me about something important. If she sought my answer as her older sister."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...I wonder if I'll be able to properly handle things like a good older sister."
choice_data_list: ...You're a bit too stubborn for your own good.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!
choice_data_list: You don't have to act like the perfect big sister— you're still her big sister no matter what.
You don't need to act like the ideal older sister. You are her older sister nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And then came the next day off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(...I didn't forget anything, right?
Handkerchief, tissues... Got the bandages for Brian, too.)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Alright...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, Bria—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Why a tracksuit?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's because we're on our way back from training.
Well then, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-Wait, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. That was a fairly interesting race.
Especially the girl in Race 9. If she continues to grow...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ? Sis?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right now, not a single person
has come to me for advice, though...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
B-Brian!?
You were the one who invited me out today, weren't you!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That is correct, yes.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Then surely there's something to discuss?
Troubles with your running form, or perhaps
thoughts on your future course of action!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Nothing in particular, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There is none?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...I see... or rather, is it not...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Did you want something to happen, sis?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
N-No. It's not that I wanted there to be one,
but I feel somewhat let down.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was certain you were going to ask me
for advice or a favor...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmm. I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Understood. Then—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Please, just like I contacted you earlier.
I need to borrow your kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It's to grant my little sister's wish.
The dorm kitchen is under renovation today,
so we can't use it."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave as soon as I finish making the curry.
I'll do my best not to be a nuisance.
So... please!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Then I shall make use of it for a few hours!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giddy with excitement, Biwa Hayahide
trotted off toward the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry I'm such a pain of an older sister.
choice_data_list: You really wanted to eat curry that badly, huh?
Did you really want to eat curry that badly?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sis looked like she really wanted me to ask something of her.
So that's all I did.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Honestly, just taking it easy and catching up
together today would have been more than enough for me."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian, I put in 4 onions just like usual~
I'll let them melt completely into the stew, so it'll be fine, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: By the way, why did you invite me out on our day off?
By the way, why did you invite me out on our day off?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I don't want to take up too much of your time on weekdays.
It'd get in the way of your training, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
“—I'm looking forward to running
with an even stronger Big Sis too.”

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun.
We managed to finish making the curry without a hitch!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Well then, we shall take our leave—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Why don't you just eat here?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Brian?
Aren't you... shy around strangers...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
At my age? No way.
Besides, you're Big Sis's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There's also something I want to ask you.
Like what you've been up to these past three years.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sis told me you're a dependable Trainer.
So for future reference, I'd like to hear you explain things while keeping Sis's commentary in mind right beside it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wh-what... Brian?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Heh, looks like we might be together
for quite a long time. I'll be counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Trainer-kun?!
Your words are technically correct,
but I feel like everything else about this is completely wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I believe I should be the one saying
"I look forward to working with you" to you?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide remains thoroughly bewildered,
while Narita Brian watches on with amusement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might not be normal,
but this, too, is surely a form of sisterhood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The curry eaten together by the three of them
tasted exceptionally delicious.
